text: Medulla oblongata, pons, midbrain, both cerebellar hemispheres and vermis, cerebellar folia are normal.
The 4th ventricle is midline and of normal width.
Basal cisterns, cerebellopontine angle cisterns, internal acoustic canal widths, 5th, 7th-8th cranial nerves are normal.
A 14 mm long diameter hypointense appearance on T2 sequence in the parietal region at the interhemispheric fissure location, consistent with falx calcification.
Cavum septum pellucidum et vergae variation.
Bilateral basal ganglia, internal and external capsules, both thalami, corpus callosum, corona radiata are normal.
No pathological intensity change detected within the cerebral parenchyma.
No area of restriction compatible with acute infarct on Diffusion-ADC mapping.
No space-occupying lesion detected in the cerebral parenchyma.
The third and both lateral ventricles are midline and of normal width.
Hemispheric cortical sulcus and gyrus structure is normal.
Main cerebral vascular structures are patent.
Cranium bone structures, both globes, retrobulbar fat tissue, optic nerves, and optic chiasm are normal.
Mild mucosal thickening in the right mastoid air cells.
Well-defined 12x10 mm mass lesion within the left suboccipital fatty tissue, hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on T2.
